policy.name: Ladakh Sustainable Industrial Policy 2022-27
policy.order_no: S.O. 02, Industries & Commerce Dept, UT Ladakh (F.No. M-11012/101/2022-Office of Dy Secy (InC)); endorsement No. Comm.Secy/I&C/UTL/141/2022 dated 21-01-2023

schemes.name: Assistance for Green Energy (Solar/Wind/Hybrid 10-2000 kW)
schemes.notes: 50% of cost of purchase and installation of solar/wind/hybrid systems 10 kW-2000 kW, max Rs 25 lakh; unit min project investment Rs 25 lakh. New units and existing units; existing units only when replacing a DG set. Paid in 3 instalments (40% after 6 months, 40% after 1 year, 20% after 2 years of operation) after DIC + Power Dept verification. Negative list (Annexure I) excluded.

schemes.name: Assistance for Pollution Control Devices
schemes.notes: EXISTING units only: 50% of cost of online monitoring / high-quality pollution control device, max Rs 20 lakh, released after commissioning report from Ladakh Pollution Control Committee. Separately, wastewater recycling/waste management technology, machinery & equipment: 50% up to Rs 2 lakh (new and existing; excludes civil works).

schemes.name: Assistance for Competitiveness, Innovation and Quality Control (testing equipment / certification)
schemes.notes: 35% of cost of in-house testing equipment OR quality certification, max Rs 5 lakh (single combined cap). Sanctioned only after unit obtains a national/international quality mark (GMP, ISO, BIS, FPO, BEE, AGMARK, ECOMARK, ZED, GHP etc.). Not for machinery used directly in manufacturing.

other_benefits: DPR cost: 50% up to Rs 50,000 for units with project cost >= Rs 25 lakh; 95% up to Rs 1 lakh for women (single mothers/widows), 40%+ disabled, third gender (6.1, 6.8)
Stamp duty & registration fee: 100% reimbursement for new units allotted land in Industrial Estates (6.2)

Transport subsidy: 50% of air freight on finished goods out of Ladakh, max Rs 5 lakh/yr for 5 years (6.3); alternatively export subsidy 60% of transport cost to port, max Rs 5 lakh/yr for 5 years + export samples up to Rs 50,000/yr for 2 years (6.7)
Trade fair participation 50% up to Rs 2 lakh / 1 lakh / 50,000 (1st/2nd/3rd time); CFC usage 50% up to Rs 1 lakh/yr for 3 years (6.6)
Wastewater recycling equipment 50% up to Rs 2 lakh (6.4)
unverifiable: No capital investment subsidy on plant & machinery, SGST reimbursement, interest subsidy, electricity duty exemption or per-unit power subsidy in the Ladakh policy.

Central scheme: the New Central Sector Scheme for Industrial Development of J&K (2021) covers the UT of J&K only. A separate central 'Industrial Development Scheme for UT of Ladakh' (reported outlay Rs 3,500 crore) was described as proposed / awaiting CCEA approval (press reports, July 2025); no notification found, so not included.

The earlier central Industrial Development Scheme 2017 for J&K (which then covered Ladakh) ran 15-06-2017 to 31-03-2022 (DIPP notification F.No. 2(2)/2018-SPS dated 23-04-2018, copy on ladakh.gov.in) - expired.
Procedural guidelines for the policy were published only as drafts (2023-10, 2024-08) on ladakh.gov.in; final guidelines not located.
